text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi ruk gayi,
Tumne pucha nahi, maine kuch kaha nahi।
Bas door se tumhe muskurate dekhna,
Yahi shayad mera sabse paak ishq tha,
Jise maine kabhi lafzon mein dhala nahi।
title: Ankahi Mohabbat
description: A soft and heartfelt social media post about silent love that was never spoken aloud.
